meta.description.zh: 吳弘叡個人網站中，陽明交大資訊工程學系的系所介紹頁面，收錄歷史沿革、人員組成與研究領域。
meta.description.en: Department introduction page for NYCU's Department of Computer Science on Hong-Ruei Wu's personal website — history, faculty, and research areas.

nycu-department-of-computer-2.zh: 陽明交大資訊工程學系

the-nycu-department-of.zh: 陽明交大資訊工程學系成立於1970年，經歷多次改革與技術進步，是台灣頂尖的資工系之一。
the-nycu-department-of.en: The NYCU Department of Computer Science was established in 1970. Through multiple reforms and advancements in technology, it has become one of Taiwan's leading CS departments.

the-department-consists-of.zh: 系上擁有50多位教授與研究員，致力於各領域的研究與教學，提供學生優質學習環境。
the-department-consists-of.en: The department consists of over 50 professors and researchers, dedicated to various fields of research and teaching, providing students with a high-quality learning environment.

research-areas-cover-artificial.zh: 涵蓋人工智慧、數據科學、嵌入式系統等多個前沿研究領域，持續引領技術創新。
research-areas-cover-artificial.en: Research areas cover artificial intelligence, data science, embedded systems, and other cutting-edge fields, continually driving technological innovation.

many-alumni-hold-key.zh: 多名校友在國際科技公司擔任要職，並在國際學術領域上取得重大突破與貢獻。
many-alumni-hold-key.en: Many alumni hold key positions in international tech companies and have made significant breakthroughs and contributions in the academic world.
